# Reference consensus source

Source: https://github.com/requant-network/requant at ef789d4 (node 0.16.0: revocable outputs and anyone-can-pay; earlier pinned at 444da68 and aad4772). Apache-2.0. Consensus and TNet source files are copied without changes. The app uses the wallet key-file format and signing/serialization rules from this revision.
